subject: Next steps: Converting OliveX invoices to AWS Marketplace (reseller path)
messages:
From: Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@olivex.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: bryan.cole@olivex.com
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal & billing question

Hi Laura —

We’re finalizing our renewal with Redwood and procurement has asked whether we can move to AWS Marketplace billing for the subscription line items. The ask is to have all invoices consolidated through Marketplace starting with the Aug renewal period.

Can you confirm if Redwood supports an entitlement mapping (current seat/SKU mapping to marketplace SKUs) and if there are any changes to pricing or terms when moving to the reseller path? Also need a sense of timing — procurement wants the transition completed before the Aug 31 renewal.

Thanks,
Amanda
Amanda Lee
Head of Customer Success, OliveX

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@olivex.com>, bryan.cole@olivex.com
Cc: connor.obrien@redwood.com, rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal & billing question

Hi Amanda — thanks for flagging this. We can absolutely move OliveX to AWS Marketplace billing and consolidate invoices via the reseller (co-sell) path. High-level notes below and I attached a draft marketplace amendment and an entitlement mapping template to start.

What changes when you move to Marketplace (high level):
- Billing & payment: Invoices come from AWS Marketplace (monthly/annual depending on the contract) rather than Redwood invoicing directly. Payment terms follow Marketplace cycles.
- Entitlements: We map your current subscription SKUs and seat counts to Marketplace SKUs (we’ll provide a mapping CSV; attached).
- Pricing: List pricing should be equivalent; any enterprise discounts are preserved via the amendment (we don’t change base unit prices on migration).
- Contract & legal: We add a Marketplace Amendment and update invoicing clauses; Redwood remains the service provider.
- Procurement/Finance impact: You’ll see consolidated Marketplace charges; usage reconciliation might shift to AWS reports rather than our PDF invoices.

Next steps I propose (timeline to hit Aug 31):
1) Today: I’ll share the draft amendment and mapping (attached).
2) Wed (7/14): Your procurement and our finance/legal align on the amendment redlines. I’ll loop Connor (legal ops) and Rafael (marketplace PM) for gating items.
3) Thu (7/15): Finalize mapping CSV and return signed amendment to Redwood.
4) Fri (7/16) — Redwood submits co-sell registration and SKU entitlements to AWS; AWS typically takes 3–5 business days to enable entitlements.
5) Target: Live in AWS Marketplace for the Aug invoice cycle.

Ask for you: please review the attached entitlement mapping and confirm current contracted SKUs + seat counts. I’ll take care of the DocuSign amendment flow and co-sell registration.

Attachments: redwood-marketplace-amendment-draft.pdf, OliveX-entitlement-mapping.csv

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Bryan Cole <bryan.cole@olivex.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: amanda.lee@olivex.com, omarsh@olivex.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 08:29:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal & billing question

Laura —

Quick note from procurement/legal: two things we need clarified in the amendment before signing:
1) Confirm that historic usage and invoiced credits apply post-migration (we had an overage credit last quarter).
2) We need a short clause about audit logs and data retention for billing disputes (OliveX legal: Olivia Marsh, cc’d).

If Redwood can add the two bullets above as explicit language in the amendment we can sign quickly. Also please confirm the expected date AWS will show entitlements in the console after you submit — our finance team needs to know when Marketplace charges will start flowing.

-Bryan
Bryan Cole
Director, Procurement — OliveX

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: bryan.cole@olivex.com, amanda.lee@olivex.com
Cc: connor.obrien@redwood.com, rafael.mendes@redwood.com, omarsh@olivex.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal & billing question

Bryan / Amanda — thanks, all good input. Updated plan and quick answers below. I’ve attached a near-final SOW/Amendment (SOW_renewal_v2.docx) with language covering both points.

Responses:
- Overages/credits: We confirm any credits or reconciliations tied to prior invoices will be honored and applied in the Marketplace billing cycle; we included explicit language in ¶3.2 of the amendment.
- Audit logs & disputes: Clause added (¶6.4) — Redwood will provide 12 months of invoice-level audit logs on request and a 30-day dispute window for Marketplace-billed items.
- AWS entitlement visibility: After we submit the co-sell SKU entitlements, AWS typically marks entitlements live in 3 business days; we’ll submit by EOD Fri (7/16) to aim for activation by Wed (7/21). Finance should expect Marketplace charges beginning with the Aug cycle if the entitlements are active by 7/21.

Immediate asks for OliveX this afternoon:
- Confirm the mapping CSV values (attached) and return with any seat corrections.
- Legal: please review the updated amendment (attached) and initial here: (I’ll send DocuSign once I have your sign-off).

I’ve looped in Connor (cc) who will help coordinate the co-sell submission and track the AWS ticket. Rafael will handle entitlement QA on our side. If you prefer, we can do a 20-minute sync tomorrow to walk procurement/legal through the two clauses.

Next steps (tight):
- Fri 7/16 EOD: final mapping + signed amendment -> Redwood sends co-sell request to AWS.
- Wed 7/21: target entitlement activation.
- Aug invoice cycle: marketplace billing begins.

DocuSign link (will be sent once you confirm): https://app.docusign.com/prepare/XXXX-olivex-amendment

Best,
Laura
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
